title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with a solid mix captures a stellar 1982 show highlighted by Jerry’s great tone and high‑energy performances.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the show’s stacked, fire‑filled vibe and specifically praise Jerry Garcia’s guitar work. The matrix source is praised for its overall mix quality, though one note mentions an original sync glitch on Crazy Fingers that has since been fixed. Overall the recording is listenable and the performance is considered a high point.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments about both musical performance (high energy, Jerry’s tone) and recording quality (nice matrix mix), with only a minor technical fix noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix praised as solid; original Crazy Fingers segment was out of sync in the source but has been corrected via splice, eliminating the issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners describe the set as stacked and high‑energy with smooth transitions, indicating a well‑flowing performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is highlighted as great throughout the show.
